error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Greece that a passport (EU) or residence permit (non-EU) alone is enough to open a bank account, sign a lease, or get a phone contract

verdict.summary: Greece requires a separate 9-digit tax registration number (AFM, Αριθμός Φορολογικού Μητρώου) issued by the tax authority AADE before a bank account, lease, or mobile contract can be finalized. Any natural person, EU or non-EU, resident or not, can apply; a passport or residence permit is one of the documents used to request the AFM, not a substitute for it. Applications are submitted online but identity must still be verified by a myAADElive video call or an in-person visit to a tax office (ΔΟΥ) - it is not a purely remote process. Asylum seekers without a full residence permit can still be assigned an AFM in person through Asylum Service offices.

dead_ends.action: Assume a passport (EU citizens) or residence permit (non-EU citizens) alone lets you open a bank account, sign a lease, or get a SIM/mobile contract in Greece
dead_ends.why_fails: AADE's official procedure (catalogued on Greece's National Registry of Administrative Procedures) requires an AFM - a separate 9-digit tax registration number - before these transactions can complete; the passport or residence permit is only one of the documents submitted to apply for the AFM, not a stand-in for it.

dead_ends.action: Tell a non-EU/third-country national without a residence permit that they cannot get an AFM at all
dead_ends.why_fails: Any natural person, regardless of nationality or residency status, can obtain an AFM. Since a process formalized in March 2021, asylum seekers holding a valid International Protection Applicant's card can be assigned an AFM in person through Asylum Service offices, hosting facilities, or Reception/Identification Centers, without first holding a full residence permit.
dead_ends.condition: Asylum seeker without a full residence permit
dead_ends.common_misconception: That AFM eligibility requires already holding a residence permit.

workarounds.action: Apply for the AFM through AADE's online portal, then complete identity verification either via the myAADElive video call or in person at a ΔΟΥ (tax office) with the required documents
workarounds.how: The application itself is submitted electronically, but Greek law requires identity verification by video call or an in-person visit before the AFM is issued - it is not a fully remote, no-visit process.
workarounds.condition: EU or non-EU applicant with a passport or residence document

workarounds.action: Asylum seekers without a residence permit should request AFM assignment directly through the Asylum Service during a registration or renewal appointment, or check assigned status at asylum.migration.gov.gr/afm
workarounds.condition: Asylum seeker holding an International Protection Applicant's card

frequently_confused_with.distinction: AFM is a tax registration number from AADE needed for banking, leases, and contracts; AMKA is a separate social-security registration number needed for employment and healthcare access. Getting one does not grant the other.
